
Rendered Markdown (document, rule and task bodies) is set for reading:

- Running text (paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, headings) is at most 72
  characters wide. Tables, code blocks and diagrams keep the full width.
- Line height is 1.65 and paragraphs are separated by 1em.
- Inline code is marked by the `--imp` colour and a faint `--surface-2` fill,
  with no border. A bordered chip every few words breaks a line into separate
  objects.

A full-width line on a wide card runs past 150 characters, and the reader
loses their place on the return sweep. Short paragraphs then read as a wall of
text.
